name: Joktan
overview: Joktan is identified in Scripture as a son of Eber, making him a key figure in the genealogical lineage recorded in Genesis 10 and 1 Chronicles 1. He is noted alongside his brother Peleg, during whose days the earth was divided, highlighting the significance of their generation. Joktan fathered several sons, including Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab, establishing a distinct family line that contributes to the broader biblical narrative of the nations.
